answer: Picture the network as a canyon an attacker spinning cheap identities still must cross. Each identity faces a fresh, unpredictable challenge every epoch, and only answers judged coherent by established peers sharing no referral edge count toward earning. A sybil swarm is a garden with no roots: its members can only validate each other, so their work pays nothing. Genuine independent effort, rare as a jade seam, is what the protocol actually rewards.
